## Description

## Type of Change

- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to not work as expected)
- [ ] Documentation update
- [ ] Refactoring (no functional changes)
- [ ] Performance improvement
- [ ] Dependency update

## Quality Checklist

### Code Quality

- [ ] Tests added/updated for new functionality
- [ ] All tests passing locally (`npm test`)
- [ ] Linting passed (`npm run lint`)
- [ ] Type checking passed (`npm run type-check`)
- [ ] No console.log statements (use proper logging)
- [ ] Code follows project conventions

### Documentation

- [ ] Documentation updated (README, JSDoc, etc.)
- [ ] Environment variables documented (if added)
- [ ] API endpoints documented (if added)
- [ ] Breaking changes documented

### Testing

- [ ] Tested on development environment
- [ ] Tested on staging/Pi (if applicable)
- [ ] E2E tests added for critical user flows (if applicable)
- [ ] Edge cases considered and tested

### Security

- [ ] No sensitive data (API keys, passwords, tokens) committed
- [ ] Input validation added for user inputs
- [ ] Authorization checks added for protected routes
- [ ] Dependencies checked for vulnerabilities
